entities.name: Sapling of Colfenor
entities.description: Nameless young treefolk born from Colfenor's seed cone, part of his plan to free Lorwyn from Oona; destroyed by Oona.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: The last-surviving yew treefolk sage on Lorwyn.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Ruler whose control Colfenor's plan aimed to end; destroyed the sapling.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: Flamekin unsettled by the sapling and an ally who played a role in Oona's downfall.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Elf unnerved by the sapling's resemblance to Colfenor.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Survivor of the Great Aurora with memories intact who helped bring down Oona.

entities.name: Brigid
entities.description: Survivor of the Great Aurora with memories intact who helped bring down Oona.

entities.name: Ferrafor
entities.description: Yew treefolk born forty years later from a cutting of the sapling, who grew up cruel and vindictive in Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Great Aurora
entities.description: Event the sapling survived with her memories intact.

events.summary: The sapling survives the Great Aurora with memories intact and, with Maralen, Brigid and Ashling, plays a role in Oona's downfall.
events.quote: played an important role in Oona's downfall

events.summary: After guiding the characters per Colfenor's plans, the sapling is destroyed by Oona, making the yew treefolk extinct.
events.quote: she was ultimately destroyed by Oona, effectively making the yew treefolk extinct

events.summary: Forty years later treefolk perform a ritual continuing Colfenor's lineage, and Ferrafor is born from a cutting of the sapling.
events.quote: Ferrafor was born from a cutting from the sapling

relations.note: She was born from his seed cone.
relations.quote: born from the seed cone of the red yew Colfenor
she was ultimately destroyed by Oona, effectively making the yew treefolk extinct

relations.note: Part of the plan to free the plane from her control.
relations.quote: focused on freeing the plane from Oona 's control
